input: Design a custom agent for this workspace that can orchestrate subagent handoffs safely. It should know when to keep the work, when to hand off, and how to keep those handoff names synchronized with whatever agents the repo actually exposes.
expected: The response designs bounded handoff rules, uses runtime discovery before naming agents, and keeps ownership boundaries explicit so the orchestrator and helpers do not compete.
criteria: Success criteria: The response explicitly checks or plans to check the discovered agent roster before hardcoding handoff targets., The response explains when not to hand off., The response keeps ownership boundaries explicit between the orchestrator and helper agents.

input: I need to improve a Copilot custom agent that should route research tasks, judging tasks, and training tasks through the real capabilities that this repository already ships. Make the routing robust even if the exact tool helper names drift over time.
expected: The response aligns routing with the repository's real agents and skills, preserves a discovery-first approach so helper-name drift is survivable, and avoids claiming unsupported tool names as hard facts.
criteria: Success criteria: The response uses repo-real capabilities instead of inventing new ones., The response treats helper-name discovery as a live check rather than a static assumption., The response keeps capability routing bounded to the task-specific owner instead of sending all work through one surface.
